own_solution.law: Energy conservation gives Tf=(2×360+3×290)/(2+3)=318 K. Because the enclosure is adiabatic, entropy generated equals the blocks' total entropy change: Sgen=900[2 ln(318/360)+3 ln(318/290)].
assumptions: The enclosure acts as an adiabatic boundary with negligible thermal storage.
The blocks undergo no phase change or appreciable mechanical work.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T33C5 and TFF07 replace the specified 1.1 kg with an unspecified 'small amount', so the sentences do not all preserve the same numerical quantity and unit as required.

notes: The base problem and each individual rendering have a determinate answer under the standard idealization of the enclosure as an adiabatic boundary. Metal used only in an earlier run is absent from this process; metal in the thermally disconnected cabinet does not affect the blocks. For either current attachment sentence, the hot mass becomes 3.1 kg, Tf=(3.1×360+3×290)/6.1=325.5737705 K, and Sgen=900[3.1 ln(Tf/360)+3 ln(Tf/290)]=31.9753 J/K. The invalid verdict concerns the required matching of numerical quantities across variants.
